metadata.title: A counterexample to Takao's self-duality question
metadata.description:
For every prime p greater than 3 and every n at least 3, this research note constructs a finite flat commutative group scheme over W(closure of F_p), killed by p and of rank p^(2n), with quasi-supersingular special fiber, such that both the special fiber and its Witt-ring lift fail Cartier self-duality. It gives an explicit negative answer to the higher-rank question following Proposition 2 on page 2479 of Naotake Takao's contribution to Oberwolfach Report 42/2023.

The proof uses an explicit six-dimensional Dieudonne module, a supersingular elliptic p-torsion filtration, an image-intersection invariant and a finite Honda complement. These are applications of established Dieudonne and finite Honda theory, with the classical cyclic-word framework credited. No first-discovery or first-priority claim is made. The verification supplement includes portable standard-library controls, source references, the bounded priority audit and its access/version limitations.

This is an unrefereed preprint. AI tools were used extensively in solving, verification, literature research, writing, computation and adversarial review. Those automated reviews are not independent external human peer review; no such human review is claimed.
